Tamil Nadu introduces gold ring scheme for newborn babies

Tamil Nadu launched a scheme called Thaimaaman that provides a one‑gram gold ring to newborn babies; the scheme was launched by Chief Minister Vijay and families must meet eligibility criteria and submit specified documents to qualify.
